title: asclepias tuberosa subsp. rolfsii
intro: Asclepias tuberosa subsp. rolfsii, commonly known as Butterfly Weed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Butterfly Weed include sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like cardenolides and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of Butterfly Weed, including secamone, asclepiadins, and cardio glycosides, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
